figures.label: Time Required
figures.source: An executive MBA is a management degree specifically designed for working professionals who stay employed full-time while studying. Classes run in a weekend or modular format, commonly alternating Friday-Saturday sessions, or intensive multi-day residencies spaced every few months, over roughly 12 to 18 months, shorter than the standard 2-year regular MBA.

figures.label: Time Required
figures.source: Eligibility is where the real filtering happens. Most credible Indian EMBA programs, including IIM-run executive programs, expect at least 5 years of full-time, post-qualification professional or managerial experience, with some flexibility for exceptional candidates around 3 years.
